measured_backend_evidence.best_config_summary: TP=2 PP=2 DeepSeek-V4-Flash on Spark4/Spark5, max_model_len=200000, max_num_batched_tokens=8192, prefix cache enabled.

custom_ds4_reference.mechanism: Build sorted routed expert pairs, batch up to 8 rows per expert tile, pass per-expert gate/up/down slice pointer tables, and run a tile8 gate/up kernel instead of scalar sorted fallback or full expert slabs.

source_evidence.finding: CUDA MXFP4 backend priority tries FlashInfer TRTLLM MXFP4/MXFP8, then DeepGEMM MXFP4, then MARLIN and BATCHED_MARLIN. A measured MARLIN selection means higher-priority candidates did not pass support checks in this deployment.

select_deepseek_v4_mxfp4_moe_backend maps explicit marlin to MARLIN or BATCHED_MARLIN based on activation format; auto selection only reaches the batched variant when the selected activation format is BatchedExperts.

The current no-DP expert-parallel prepare/finalize path reports activation_format=Standard, quantizes the whole activation tensor, uses one dispatcher, and does not build a per-expert batched activation queue.

use_batched_activation_format is enabled through DeepEP low-latency or NIXL expert-parallel all2all paths; use_all2all_kernels requires dp_size > 1 and expert parallel. The TP=2 no-DP lane therefore does not enable BatchedExperts activation format.

BatchedMarlinExperts exists and declares BatchedExperts activation format with per-expert batched workspaces, so the missing piece is topology/prepare-finalize routing rather than total absence of a batched MXFP4 expert implementation.
DeepseekV4MoE uses the normal FusedMoE path unless moe_backend is deep_gemm_mega_moe; the standard run did not activate the mega-MoE route.
DeepSeek V4 creates a ParallelLMHead and compute_logits calls LogitsProcessor over the full lm_head path. Normal generation is not using a candidate-only scorer.

LogitsProcessor has a get_top_tokens helper that all-gathers only top token/value pairs, but normal _get_logits applies the full lm_head and gathers/slices logits. Grep showed get_top_tokens used by proposer/spec-decode paths, not DeepSeek V4 normal compute_logits.

The MXFP4 fused gate/up tensor exists as w13_weight with shape (num_experts, 2 * intermediate_size_per_partition, hidden_size // 2), plus MXFP4 block scales. There is a gate/up analog to optimize, but the layout is MXFP4/Marlin rather than the DS4 IQ2/Q8 slice-tile8 layout.
The custom DS4 patch series routes sorted expert-pair gate/up/down tile kernels through per-expert slice pointer tables and keeps expert-tile kernels enabled under batched expert slice caching.

opportunities.why: vLLM already has BatchedMarlinExperts, but the current TP=2 no-DP path forces Standard activations. A narrow prototype can add a no-DP batched prepare/finalize route or explicit backend experiment to test whether this recovers DS4-style expert-tile occupancy.
opportunities.risk: BatchedMarlin workspace scales with num_experts * max_num_tokens * num_dispatchers; it may increase memory use or require row/expert metadata that the current no-DP path does not materialize.
opportunities.next_action: Prototype an opt-in no-DP BatchedExperts activation path for MXFP4 MARLIN, or first run an explicit BATCHED_MARLIN support probe with memory logging.

opportunities.why: Auto backend priority checks FlashInfer TRTLLM and DeepGEMM before MARLIN. Since the measured deployment selected MARLIN, the missing data is the exact support-check rejection reason, not whether these backends exist.
opportunities.risk: Explicit backend launch may fail at startup, but the failure text is the desired artifact if it names unsupported architecture, missing library, activation format, or quantization constraint.
opportunities.next_action: Run short startup probes for moe_backend=deep_gemm, flashinfer_trtllm_afp8, flashinfer_trtllm, and deep_gemm_mega_moe on the same image, capturing support-check failures before changing kernels.

opportunities.why: Normal DeepSeek V4 generation calls full ParallelLMHead logits. Existing get_top_tokens avoids full logits for proposer paths only, and previous grammar masking did not improve throughput because it did not replace output-head work with candidate-only scoring.
opportunities.risk: Candidate-only scoring changes semantics unless the request is explicitly constrained to the candidate set; it is not a drop-in replacement for unconstrained chat.
opportunities.next_action: Add a separate constrained-output provider path that scores declared candidates directly instead of using structured-output masking over full logits.

opportunities.why: DS4 slice-tile8 kernels target the custom IQ2/Q8 routed-MoE layout and per-expert slice cache, while vLLM's DeepSeek V4 path stores MXFP4 packed weights and Marlin/DeepGEMM/FlashInfer backend-specific layouts.
opportunities.risk: A direct port would likely be incorrect and slower unless it first reimplements MXFP4 decode, scales, routing metadata, and backend workspace contracts.
opportunities.next_action: Do not copy the CUDA kernel directly; instead map the same idea onto vLLM's existing MXFP4 backend interfaces.

opportunities.why: The repo-owned vLLM patches for safetensors early filtering and layerwise MXFP4 finalize reduce load-time memory pressure, not steady-state MoE throughput.
opportunities.risk: Treating these patches as performance fixes would mask the actual runtime bottleneck.
opportunities.next_action: Keep these patches for startup capacity only; do not expect them to raise decode tok/s.

analysis_result.most_likely_missing_4x_like_path: Batched/sliced expert activation routing for the MXFP4 MoE backend, not a scheduler flag.
analysis_result.why_not_guess: The code shows the measured lane is MARLIN with Standard activations, while BatchedMarlin and DeepGEMM/FlashInfer candidates exist but are not active. The next experiment should test those exact code gates.

recommended_next_experiment: Before writing a new kernel, capture explicit backend rejection reasons for DeepGEMM/FlashInfer and prototype an opt-in no-DP BatchedExperts activation path for MXFP4 MARLIN. If that improves MoE occupancy, then map DS4's sorted expert-pair tile idea into vLLM's MXFP4 backend instead of copying the IQ2/Q8 slice-tile8 kernel.
